data.text:
Ashish Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Excise ... on 31 
August, 2024 
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:59919-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 7450 of 2024
Petitioner :- Ashish Jaiswal
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Excise Deptt. Govt. Civil Sectt. Lko And 6
Counsel for Petitioner :- Lalji Yadav,Balram Yadav 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Standing Counsel for the respondents. 
2. This writ petition has been filed for the following main prayer:-
" (i). issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents no. 2 and 7 to consider and issue the license to the petitioner for running the restaurant with Bar at 260, Sangipur Raebareli Road, Tehsil Lalganj, Pratapgarh expeditiously within time stipulated by this Hon'ble Court."
3. It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner has applied for grant of a license for running a Ashish Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Excise ... on 31 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72404763/
1 restaurant with Bar namely Vinayak Restaurant & Bar, Sangipur, Raebareli Road, Tehsil Lalganj,
District Pratapgarh.
4. The license for running the Bar requires a No Objection Certificate. from Nagar Panchayat, which has been given by the Nagar Panchayat, Lalgang, Pratapgarh. The Chief Fire Officer, respondent no.
5 has also given feasibility report on 29.09.2003. The Food Safety and Drugs Administration has also given a license to the petitioner but even after all formalities having been completed, the District Excise Officer is sitting tight over the matter, hence the present petition has been filed with the aforesaid prayer. 
5. Learned counsel for the State respondents has produced a copy of the instructions sent by District Excise Officer, Pratapgarh dated 29.08.2024, which is kept on record, wherein it has been stated that under Rules 6 (1) (J) of the relevant Rules of U.P. Abkari Niyamawali, 2020, which states that a Bar License shall not be granted unless the premises is not situated within a district of 500 mts of the outer edge of a National or State Highway or of its service lane along the highway and the premises shall not be either visible or directly accessible from a National or State Highway. The proviso to the said Rule also states that in case of areas comprised in local bodies with a population of 20,000 or less, the distance shall be 220 metres. It is also provided further that aforesaid restrictions shall not be applied to the licensed establishments falling within the purview of municipal areas. 
6. In pursuance of the Rules as amended from time to time, the Excise Commissioner, Prayagraj,
has issued a circular on 05.07.2024 regarding a check list to be properly filled up for issuance of Bar License and in the said check list, at Serial No.4 mention has been made of the amended Rules 6(1)(J) of the Rules of 2020. The petitioner's address as mentioned in the application is Vinayak Restaurant, Near Hero Agency, Town Area, Lalgang, Police Station Lalganj, District Pratapgarh and the area is adjacent to National Highway, Pratapgarh market on and the premises was found 20.21.mt away from National Highway -31 whereas it should a minimum distance of 220 metre from the National Highway-31. There were other discrepancies /short comings also found with regard to the area of Kitchen and the area of Hall.
7. This writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the District Excise Officer, Pratapgarh to inform the petitioner of the short comings found in his application within a period of ten days from the date of certified copy of the order is produced before him. The petitioner shall try and satisfy the conditions laid down in the Rules, 2020 and the Circular dated 05.07.2024 and submit a fresh application, if need be, to the District Excise Officer.
Order Date :- 31.8.2024 Pks  Ashish Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Excise ... on 31 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72404763/
